_doc: Synthetic local workflow lanes for the agent workspace UI. These are demo coordination plans, not proof of an autonomous execution engine.

workflows.title: Daily Ops Loop
workflows.status: Command keeps intake, schedule, finance, and memory current.

steps.label: Intake sweep
steps.summary: New work is classified by source, urgency, and required gate.

steps.label: Route work
steps.summary: Active items are assigned to the right local channel with a visible next action.

steps.label: Cash check
steps.summary: Invoices and spend risks are checked before any paid action moves.

steps.label: Archive decision
steps.summary: Final decisions are written to the memory surface after review.

workflows.title: Career Pipeline
workflows.status: Opportunity discovery feeds pursuit follow-up and review.

steps.label: Scan signals
steps.summary: Find matching roles, clients, and partnership leads from the local source list.

steps.label: Shortlist fit
steps.summary: Turn promising leads into ranked next steps with owner and due date.

steps.label: Review language
steps.summary: Check outbound wording before anything is sent externally.

workflows.title: Build / Review
workflows.status: Research, implementation, and review stay in one loop.

steps.label: Collect context
steps.summary: Gather implementation constraints and source references.

steps.label: Make change
steps.summary: Patch the smallest useful slice and keep unrelated files untouched.

steps.label: Verify
steps.summary: Run local tests, inspect browser routes, and flag release risks.

workflows.title: Approval Gates
workflows.status: Consequential work remains behind explicit operator gates.

steps.label: Score risk
steps.summary: Classify deploy, spend, real-send, publish, merge, and secret actions.

steps.label: Explain gate
steps.summary: Summarize why a queued action needs approval before it can proceed.

steps.label: Record decision
steps.summary: Append the approved or rejected decision to local memory.

workflows.title: Release Readiness
workflows.status: Runtime health, release notes, and gates converge before handoff.

steps.label: Runtime watch
steps.summary: Watch server routes, browser console health, and runtime start/stop state.

steps.label: Smoke routes
steps.summary: Confirm the verified routes and browser screens still load cleanly.

steps.label: Final gate
steps.summary: Hold any publish, deploy, or merge action until the operator approves.

workflows.title: Trade Research Loop
workflows.status: Market, technical, fundamental, sentiment, on-chain, and tokenomics signals roll up to a gated research brief.

steps.label: Morning brief
steps.summary: Prepare a dated market brief from operator-approved inputs.

steps.label: Signal sweep
steps.summary: Collect fast market, technical, sentiment, and on-chain signals.

steps.label: Synthesize
steps.summary: Merge research into educational scenarios before risk review.

workflows.title: Trade Risk Loop
workflows.status: Risk sizing, alert design, and exit planning stay research-only until approved.

steps.label: Risk matrix
steps.summary: Convert research scenarios into risk notes and paper-trade boundaries.

steps.label: Exit plan
steps.summary: Draft exit criteria without live order execution.

steps.label: Alert design
steps.summary: Prepare alerts for review without connecting to real brokerage execution.

workflows.title: Trade Learning Loop
workflows.status: Journal, autopsy, weekly review, and report packaging turn paper-trade history into lessons.

steps.label: Journal
steps.summary: Capture structured paper-trade notes and context.

steps.label: Weekly review
steps.summary: Summarize patterns for the coach and risk manager.

steps.label: Package report
steps.summary: Prepare report outlines for approval before distribution.

workflows.title: Paid Project Loop
workflows.status: Consulting, legal discovery, and portfolio monitoring lanes stay proof-backed and gated.

steps.label: Curate assets
steps.summary: Turn notes and assets into reusable paid-service playbooks.

steps.label: Domain review
steps.summary: Organize document review without legal determinations.

steps.label: Proof bundle
steps.summary: Package evidence for customer review before any send.

workflows.title: Platform Delivery Loop
workflows.status: Architecture, integration, implementation, QA, and release packaging move together.

steps.label: Shape slice
steps.summary: Keep the delivery scope small, testable, and aligned to existing patterns.

steps.label: Build
steps.summary: Implement the API and UI slice with matching data contracts.

steps.label: QA / security
steps.summary: Probe routes, buttons, and tenant-safety assumptions before release.

workflows.title: SaaS Control Loop
workflows.status: Tenant onboarding, billing quota, runtime, fast verify, and proof-of-work stay auditable.

steps.label: Onboard tenant
steps.summary: Prepare setup checklists without granting access or changing billing.

steps.label: Runtime state
steps.summary: Track per-tenant readiness and incident notes.

steps.label: Verify packet
steps.summary: Bundle evidence for approval before consequential actions.

workflows.title: Product Catalog Loop
workflows.status: Capabilities are cataloged, evaluated, and packaged only when evidence supports the claim.

steps.label: Plan bundle
steps.summary: Group paid agents into coherent capability packages.

steps.label: Curate catalog
steps.summary: Map each capability to source paths and proof notes.

steps.label: Evaluate
steps.summary: Define pass/fail expectations before readiness is advertised.

workflows.title: Customer Growth Loop
workflows.status: Customer comms, launch drafts, and SDR work remain draft-only until reviewed.

steps.label: Customer update
steps.summary: Draft customer-facing status updates from verified evidence.

steps.label: Launch draft
steps.summary: Prepare launch material with claim-evidence checks.

steps.label: Lead shortlist
steps.summary: Research leads and draft outreach without sending.

workflows.title: Growth Ops Loop
workflows.status: Communications, lead research, and cost awareness stay coordinated for paid growth work.

steps.label: Draft update
steps.summary: Turn verified work into review-ready communication drafts.

steps.label: Review cost
steps.summary: Check usage and spend implications before campaigns or customer promises.

steps.label: Gate send
steps.summary: Hold outbound sends and public claims until approved.
